name: taller-silver
description: Taller Silver Core Engine — plataforma modular multi-tenant para gestión de talleres

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @taller/api" "npm run dev -w @taller/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @taller/shared && npm run build -w @taller/api && npm run build -w @taller/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @taller/shared && npm run build -w @taller/api
